ios.desc:
Learn a new language without opening a flashcard app.                                                                       
                                                                                                                            
Linguisticat is a smart Safari extension that gently replaces words on websites you already read with vocabulary from your  
target language. Just browse the web normally, and absorb new words naturally through real-world context.                   
                                                                                                                            
How Linguisticat Works:                                                                                                     
Instead of interrupting your routine with grammar drills, Linguisticat turns your everyday browsing into an immersive       
learning environment.                                                                                                       
• If you are learning Spanish and reading an article in English, we might translate the word "water" to "[agua]".           
• You learn passively through context and repetition—zero extra effort required.                                            
                                                                                                                            
Why You’ll Love It:                                                                                                         
• Zero Friction Learning: No cramming, no scheduling. You learn while doing what you already do online.                     
• Learn Multiple Languages: Study Spanish for travel, Dutch for work, and Korean for fun—all at the same time.              
• Adapts to Your Level: Our smart engine tracks your vocabulary and introduces new words at the perfect pace.               
• The Ultimate Companion: A perfect addition to Duolingo, Babbel, or Anki to help you build real muscle memory.             
                                                                                                                            
Supported Languages:                                                                                                        
Learn Spanish, French, German, Korean, Japanese, Italian, Dutch, Chinese, and more!
